mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCM_SYS_FILE ( FILE_ID, MNU_ID, SHT_NM, FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, MIME_TYPE, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{mnuId}, #{shtNm}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{uploadedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, MNU_ID, SHT_NM, FILE_NM, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, MIME_TYPE, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT, DELETED_YN FROM SCM_SYS_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
